title: Cover essential business operating expenses
summary: Payroll, rent, utilities, insurance, software, subcontractors, professional services. Categorize precisely for tax planning.
detailsHtml:
Cash flow timing

Most business failures are cash flow failures rather than profitability failures. A profitable business can still fail if customers pay in 90 days while payroll is due in 14. Track Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) and Days Payable Outstanding (DPO) monthly; tighten collections and extend payables strategically.
